algorithm: Remove a forced horizontal row when n is odd, then check that the remaining horizontal count is even and within the paired-column capacity.
correctness_argument: An odd-height board has an odd number of cells in each column, forcing at least m/2 horizontal dominoes with the same parity as that row. After it is removed, 2x2 blocks contribute either zero or two horizontals, and a possible odd final column is vertical. These bounds and parity conditions also give a construction.
problem_understanding: If n is odd, allocate m/2 horizontal dominoes to one row.
